$comment: The home's four carousels as a small film production (krizaka-internal#2450): one look across every shot (night or golden-hour Montréal, warm lamp light, brick, blue ink, the feather pen, film grain, the birds as the brand's characters), the founder's published reels as the source. Each shot is cut from its reel on one continuous take (a cut inside a take is not expanded by the model), then expanded to 16:9 by Runway Aleph 2.0 (video to video, targetAspectRatio 16:9) with the shared look prompt plus the shot's own. The phone plays the original vertical cut, so nothing is invented there. Re-run: node scripts/home-showcase.mjs render <shot|carousel> --env-file <env>; then upload with scripts/cdn-assets.mjs. Takes and costs: content/films/home-showcase.log.json. Titles on the image are the reels' own words, already published on @krizakahq; no new claim is written on a picture. Besides the reels' shots, each carousel holds clips already in 16:9 (« clips »): the brand film, what Sovkora generated for the blog, and the company media library (public use waits on the founder's annex B, flagged « library »). Their phone rendition is a 4:5 crop placed on the subject (« focus », 0 = left, 0.5 = centre).
look: Expand the frame to a wide cinematic 16:9 shot. Continue the scene naturally on both sides with the same light, palette, lens, depth of field and 35 mm film grain: Montréal, dark and warm, lamp light or blue hour, real textures. Keep everything already in the frame exactly as it is, including the centred title text and the small mono line at the top. Add no new text, no logo, no sign, no screen, no face, no person.
